caption:
Someone on your team asks for a raise and the answer is no.

“Let me see what I can do” feels kind in the room. It costs you their trust three months later.

Which of these have you heard from your own manager?

#newmanager #leadership #management

slides.label: The answer is no
slides.headline: They asked for a raise. You can’t give it.
slides.sub: What you say next decides if they still trust you in March.

slides.headline: Saying no to a raise
rows: “The answer is no for this cycle. Here is why.”
“Let me see what I can do.”
“This is what would change the answer.”
“Let’s look at it again in March.”

slides.headline: A clear no is kinder than a slow <u>maybe</u>.
slides.sub: They can plan around no. They can’t plan around maybe.
